content:
cora: Quick quarterly OKR milestone check-in — please drop shipped vs slipped + next actions for owners. TL;DR: Shipped: model-ops rollout v1, dashboard 2.1. Slipped: cache-sharding, viz A/B. Owners: @diego (model-ops), @mei (runtime), @liam (infra). Please reply with one-liners. Thanks :pray:

 diego: Shipped: model-ops v1 canary -> 100% on dedicated, perf looks good. PR merged: #4821. Slipped: cache-sharding delayed due to DB migration risk. Owner for migration is @liam. Next action: scheduling window.

 mei: Noted a perf regression in canary for p50 at seqlen 1024 — investigation ongoing. Logged here: `INC-2026-042`.

 cora: @mei can you summarize impact? is rollback needed? :eyes:

 mei: p50 up ~18% on canary for specific prompt shapes, fallback to v0.9 avoids regression. No rollback yet; will push patch this afternoon. Owner: @mei. :wrench:

 liam: DB migration for cache-sharding requires new enum column + backfill. I can run migration but need a 2h window and a DB replica snapshot. Proposed window: Thu 03:00-05:00 UTC. Anyone object?

 diego: ACK on window. I'll freeze codemerge to main for that period. @cora can we confirm release cadence?

 cora: Accept window. Product won't ship new experiments during that slot. Thanks.

 anya: Heads-up: need to update autoscaler policy in Dedicated before migration (scale down on lock). I'll add runbook steps. Owner: @anya.

 liam: Adding runbook now: ```/usr/local/bin/migrate_cache_shard --step=backfill --db=primary```

 deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled by @diego for `model-ops v1 -> dedicated` at 2026-04-12T03:30:00Z :rocket:

 mei: Quick CR ping: PR https://git.redwood/ri/runtime/pull/519 needs review (2 small fixes). @diego @liam please take a look.

 diego: Reviewing now. ETA 30m.

 cora: Updated owners: cache-sharding: @liam (infra), backfill script: @mei, autoscaler: @anya, rollout verification: @diego. If anything slips, post here with reason + new ETA. :calendar:

 liam: Post-mortem note: if backfill runs > 45m we'll pause and open incident. Agree?

 anya: Agree. I'll monitor and be on-call for the window.

 mei: Patch pushed. `git log --oneline -n1` -> `f3b8a9c fix: handle large-kv prefix`.

 diego: Merged and rolled to canary. Observability dashboards updated: https://dashboards.redwood/ops/model-ops

 cora: Thanks all. I'll compile short status to execs after migration. If anything urgent before Thu, ping here. :white_check_mark:
